examples.knowledge_point: Multiplying a Matrix With Variable Entries by a Column Vector
examples.worked_solution:
We multiply each row in the matrix by the column vector using the dot product:

$$
\begin{aligned}Ax & =[\begin{aligned}a & c \\ b & d\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}3 \\ 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}a\cdot 3+c\cdot 2 \\ b\cdot 3+d\cdot 2\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}3a+2c \\ 3b+2d\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
